notes: OBS 30+ default dock layout after Docks, Reset Docks, on a 1920x1080 window. Studio Mode splits the preview in two.

menu-bar.desc: Menu bar along the top: File, Edit, View, Docks, Tools

preview.desc: Large preview of the current scene

scenes-dock.desc: Scenes list, bottom row far left

sources-dock.desc: Sources list, bottom row second from left

sources-add-button.desc: Plus button at the bottom left of the Sources dock

scenes-add-button.desc: Plus button at the bottom left of the Scenes dock

audio-mixer.desc: Audio Mixer meters and faders, bottom row middle

scene-transitions.desc: Scene Transitions dock, right of the mixer

controls-dock.desc: Controls dock with Start Recording and Settings, bottom right

status-bar.desc: Status bar with recording timer and CPU use
